prompt_uz: Ingliz tilida auditoriya oldida nutq so'zlashdan oldin kuchli hayajon va xavotir sezaman.
prompt_en: I feel a strong sense of nervousness before speaking English in front of peers.

prompt_uz: Ingliz tilida gapirayotganimda boshqa talabalar mening xatolarim ustidan kulyapti deb o'ylayman.
prompt_en: I worry that other students might laugh at my mistakes when I speak English.

prompt_uz: O'qituvchi ingliz tilida kutilmaganda mendan javob so'rasa, o'zimni yo'qotib qo'yaman.
prompt_en: I get flustered when the teacher unexpectedly calls on me in English.

prompt_uz: Darsda murakkab matn yoki audiomaterial berilganda darhol taslim bo'lish hissi paydo bo'ladi.
prompt_en: I feel overwhelmed when confronted with dense or authentic language materials.

prompt_uz: Ingliz tili imtihoni yoki nazorat ishidan oldin yurak urishim tezlashadi, hatto tayyor bo'lsam ham.
prompt_en: My heart pounds before an English test even when I am well prepared.

prompt_uz: O'qituvchi mening har bir xatomni tuzatsa, keyingi safar gapirishga jur'at qilmayman.
prompt_en: When the teacher corrects every mistake I make, I lose the courage to speak next time.
source: FLCAS, item 19 — adapted (fear of negative evaluation)

prompt_uz: Ingliz tilida yozgan ishimni boshqalar o'qishini tasavvur qilsam, noqulaylik sezaman.
prompt_en: I feel uneasy imagining others reading what I have written in English.
source: Second Language Writing Anxiety Inventory (Cheng, 2004) — adapted

prompt_uz: Bir mashg'ulotda 15-20 ta yangi kasbiy atama va murakkab sintaktik tuzilmani o'zlashtirish menga qiyinchilik tug'dirmaydi.
prompt_en: I comfortably absorb 15-20 new academic collocations in a single session.

prompt_uz: Uzoq (400-500 so'zli) ilmiy-pedagogik maqolalarni o'qib, asosiy tezislarini ajratib olishga sabrim yetadi.
prompt_en: I maintain focus while analyzing extended pedagogical observation texts.

prompt_uz: Bir vaqtning o'zida audio tinglab, konspekt yozib va savolga javob tayyorlay olaman.
prompt_en: I can listen, take notes and prepare an answer at the same time without losing track.

prompt_uz: Yozma yoki og'zaki topshiriqlarni belgilangan vaqtdan oldinroq, tez va dadil bajarishga odatlanganman.
prompt_en: I usually complete written drafting tasks ahead of standard deadlines.

prompt_uz: Javob berishdan oldin uzoq o'ylanib qolmayman, fikrimni tezkor ifoda eta olaman.
prompt_en: I articulate my thoughts promptly without prolonged hesitation.

prompt_uz: Yangi grammatik qoidani bir marta tushuntirilgach, darhol mashqda qo'llay olaman.
prompt_en: After a rule is explained once, I can apply it in practice straight away.

prompt_uz: Topshiriq bajarishda tayyor namuna yoki o'qituvchi yordamisiz mustaqil strategiya tanlay olaman.
prompt_en: I can devise an autonomous writing strategy without leaning on templates.

prompt_uz: O'z xatolarimni mustaqil tahlil qilish va o'zlashtirish kamchiliklarini to'ldirish menga qulay.
prompt_en: I regularly conduct self-diagnosis of my linguistic errors.

prompt_uz: Ishni topshirishdan oldin o'z matnimni rubrika mezonlari bo'yicha o'zim tekshirib chiqaman.
prompt_en: Before submitting, I check my own text against the rubric criteria myself.

prompt_uz: Sun'iy intellektdan tayyor javob olishdan ko'ra, avval o'zim urinib ko'rishni afzal ko'raman.
prompt_en: I prefer to attempt a task myself first rather than get a ready answer from AI.

prompt_uz: Ingliz tilini yaxshi o'rganishimdan maqsad — kelajakda kuchli, xalqaro tajribaga ega metodist-o'qituvchi bo'lish.
prompt_en: My primary drive is to become an inspiring, pedagogically proficient English educator.
source: L2 Motivational Self System (Dörnyei, 2009) — ideal L2 self, adapted

prompt_uz: Men uchun faqat imtihondan yuqori baho olish emas, balki tilni chuqur his qilish muhim.
prompt_en: Intrinsic linguistic mastery matters to me far more than mere test scores.

prompt_uz: Dars tashqarisida ham ingliz tilida podkast, maqola yoki video tanlab o'rganishga vaqt ajrataman.
prompt_en: Outside class I voluntarily spend time on English podcasts, articles or videos.
